title: Bug: Missing definitions for Arista-7260CX3-Q44
author: justin-wong-ce
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

There are missing definitions for `Arista-7260CX3-Q44` in various parts of sonic-mgmt that is needed for tests to pass.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the sonic-mgmt test suite on a `Arista-7260CX3-Q44` and observe KeyError failures when tests attempt to access HwSKU definitions.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The tests should not run into KeyError fails and be able to grab the right information.
